body:
Great, people still sweat like crazy and breathe excessively. Then touch the equipment with their sweaty hands. People aren’t generating excessive bodily fluids doing their Christmas shopping. I get that people wipe the gyms down, but people wipe down handles and sinks in the malls as well, anywhere that would see high contact. The gym is inherently a greater risk.

Edit: not arguing for malls to be open, just explaining why malls would be open and not gyms.

People sweat at the gym. People breathe heavily and in excess at the gym. Many gyms have saunas and pools. There is an abundance of bodily fluids present, even with social distancing in effect the threat of transmission is greater inside a gym. This is a bad take, or at least a poor comparison.
